RekSaiPassive.name: Fury of the Xer'Sai
RekSaiPassive.tooltip:
Rek'Sai generates @FuryFromAttacks@ Fury when she Attacks and @FuryFromAbilities@ Fury from Abilities.

While Burrowed, she consumes her Fury to restore up to @HealAmount@ Health over @HealDuration@ seconds, increasing with level.
